dedupe_keys.name: akure ilesha ten kilometre gsm drive test signals

description: This dataset contains GSM signal strength, timestamps and geographic coordinates along ten kilometres of the Akure–Ilesha road in Ondo State, Nigeria. Reuben Diarah and collaborators place a data-acquisition system and laptop inside a moving vehicle to record how received signals vary along the route and between base-station areas. Mendeley provides one Excel workbook free under CC BY 4.0. The repository describes date and time fields but does not establish exact collection dates or a uniform sampling interval in its brief metadata. Coverage is limited to the driven route and recording equipment; it is not a representative regional operator-coverage survey. A reviewer-assessed use is checking road-corridor signal-loss assumptions or calibrating simple spatial radio models within communications simulations. platform-ns-3 is a related network simulation environment, without a checked conversion from the workbook. No measurements were downloaded and no propagation model was fitted.
name: Akure–Ilesha ten-kilometre GSM drive-test signals
